summary: Iteration 2 frontend regression: red theme swap + new slideshows + animated backgrounds. All target test IDs (showcase-tab-{logo|letter|social|cert}, showcase-slideshow-{key}, dm-slideshow-{logos|letterheads|cards|social|ads}, compliance-slideshow-certs) render. Slideshow next/prev navigation works across home/DM/compliance pages, dot indicators highlight correctly, autoplay advances after ~4s. Tab switching on home Showcase swaps slideshow content correctly. Zero amber (#FFB300/#FFC940) occurrences in rendered DOM across all pages; red (#EF2B3B) is dominant accent (131 matches on home). No horizontal scroll on desktop or mobile (390px). No JS console errors, no broken images. Contact form (POST /api/contact) regression — submitted successfully and shows success toast.
critical_code_review_comments: Slideshow.jsx autoplay (3800ms) keeps running while the user is interacting; consider pausing on hover or after user clicks prev/next to avoid the carousel auto-jumping mid-read. Embla has plugins for this (embla-carousel-autoplay) which expose stopOnInteraction.

Slideshow.jsx counter and dot indicators rely on emblaApi.scrollSnapList() which returns 1 snap per slide due to align:'start' + non-100% basis. With basis-[30%] on lg, count=6 is still correct but on very wide viewports the last 1-2 slides may be permanently visible without ever becoming the 'selected' snap; consider align:'center' or containScroll:'trimSnaps'.
PortfolioMocks.jsx LOGO_ITEMS has 6 items but BUSINESS_CARD_ITEMS has only 5 — minor inconsistency in slideshow length per category.

BackgroundFX is rendered inside many sections with overflow-hidden — verify it doesn't accumulate paint cost on long pages; consider IntersectionObserver-based mounting if FPS drops on lower-end devices.
Several slideshow renderers (LogoCard, LetterheadCard, etc.) use absolute-positioned text that could overlap the gradient overlay at extreme zoom; visual spot-check at 200% zoom recommended.
seed_data_creation: 1 contact message via POST /api/contact (TEST_Iter2 User / iter2test@example.com) — left in DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter 2 added home Showcase section (data-testid=home-showcase) with 4 tabs and 4 slideshows, plus dm-slideshow-* on /design-marketing and compliance-slideshow-certs on /compliance. Slideshow internal counter is the .font-mono element matching /\d{2}\s*\/\s*\d{2}/ — use that, NOT the eyebrow font-mono which appears first in the DOM. Embla has loop:true and a 3800ms autoplay; for assertion stability either disable autoplay in test mode or read state within 800ms of the click. PREV/NEXT testids follow `${slideshow-testid}-prev` / `-next`. Contact form input-service is a <select>, use page.select_option(value=...). Color scheme: zero amber, dominant red #EF2B3B confirmed.
rca of the issue: No bugs found requiring fixes. Single observation: under rapid back-to-back PREV/NEXT clicks (< 700ms apart), Embla may debounce/queue the second event and the counter stays put — this is library-internal behavior, not a regression, and a real user click cadence does not trigger it.
